title: CobbleSafari + Extra Eeveelutions Compatibility Pack
description: Allows compatibility between CobbleSafari by Maxigregrze and Extra Eeveelutions by Cykosu by adding spawns for each Eeveelution to the Safari Zone of the former.
body:
Allows compatibility between CobbleSafari by Maxigregrze and Extra Eeveelutions by Cykosu by adding spawns for each Eeveelution to the Safari Zone dimension. Both plugins are required for this pack to do anything.

Add the .zip file to your world or server's /datapacks/ folder to install. Do not unzip.

Extra Eeveelutions by Cykosu: https://modrinth.com/datapack/extra-eeveelutions

CobbleSafari by maxigregrze: https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblesafari
